svg.title: Why progressive skill architecture matters
svg.desc: A flat library exposes every eligible skill at once. When measured local pressure appears, a progressive library can keep exact records off prompt, apply deterministic policy before search, inspect the selected candidate, activate only the pinned version, load named resources conditionally, and evaluate outcomes. The intended value is selective context, explicit authority, observable routing, and reversible change.

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p: Add control only when evidence justifies it
